medieval-christmas-market-at-britz-palac.name: Medieval Christmas Market at Britz Palace

nowkoelln-xmas-flowmarkt.name: Nowkoelln Xmas Flowmarkt
nowkoelln-xmas-flowmarkt.description: This Christmas market on Maybachufer attracts visitors with all kinds of handmade goods.

rudow-christmas-mile.name: Rudow Christmas Mile

christmas-market-on-the-dicke-linda.name: Christmas Market on the Dicke Linda
christmas-market-on-the-dicke-linda.description: Every year, the slightly sleepy Kranoldplatz in Neukölln hosts an relaxed Christmas market with charm and special offers.

christmas-bazaar-in-britz.name: Christmas Bazaar in Britz
christmas-bazaar-in-britz.description: The Marienfelder Weg allotment garden site attracts visitors to Britz on the second weekend of Advent with a Christmas market.

christmas-market-on-alexanderplatz.name: Christmas Market on Alexanderplatz
christmas-market-on-alexanderplatz.opening_times: 11 am to 10 pm, December 24 from 11 am to 2 pm
christmas-market-on-alexanderplatz.description: Every year, Alexanderplatz is the perfect place to get into the Christmas spirit. In 2026, the popular market will be divided into two clearly defined areas.

wintermuenze.name: Wintermünze
wintermuenze.description: The Alte Münze in the Nikolaiviertel is transformed into a cozy winter market at Christmas time.

bloody-x-mas-market.name: Bloody X-Mas Market
bloody-x-mas-market.description: When Wacken Open Air and the Berlin Charité run a joint Christmas market, things can get bloody.

christmas-bazaar-in-the-atrium-of-the-fe.name: Christmas Bazaar in the Atrium of the Federal Foreign Office
christmas-bazaar-in-the-atrium-of-the-fe.opening_times: Friday from 3 pm to 6 pm, Saturday from 12 noon to 6 pm
christmas-bazaar-in-the-atrium-of-the-fe.description: The Christmas bazaar of the Federal Foreign Office attracts visitors with curiosities from all over the world.

christmas-magic-in-buch.name: Christmas Magic in Buch
christmas-magic-in-buch.description: In a historical setting, Berlin-Buch celebrates the holiday season with a medieval Christmas market.

sustainable-christmas-market-at-schoenha.name: Sustainable Christmas Market at Schönhausen Palace

st-nicholas-market-at-the-children-s-far.name: St. Nicholas Market at the Children's Farm Pinke-Panke
st-nicholas-market-at-the-children-s-far.description: The Pinke-Panke farm hosts a Christmas festival for children on the second of Advent.

advent-bazaar-of-the-kaspar-hauser-found.name: Advent Bazaar of the Kaspar Hauser Foundation
advent-bazaar-of-the-kaspar-hauser-found.description: The Kaspar Hauser Foundation invites you once again to its traditional Advent bazaar this year – this time, however, on the grounds of the Konrad Duden School.

spandauer-winterland.name: Spandauer Winterland

christmas-market-at-spandau-city-hall.name: Christmas Market at Spandau City Hall
christmas-market-at-spandau-city-hall.description: The Spandau Christmas Dream market attracts visitors with rides and a Christmas carnival atmosphere.

christmas-market-at-the-evangelical-st-j.name: Christmas Market at the Evangelical St. John's Foundation
christmas-market-at-the-evangelical-st-j.description: After a contemplative Advent service, the small Christmas market at the Evangelical St. John's Foundation (Evangelisches Johannesstift) in Spandau puts visitors in a festive mood.

social-christmas-market-in-spandau.name: Social Christmas Market in Spandau
social-christmas-market-in-spandau.description: Every December it gets Christmassy at the Goldnetz social market. The Social Christmas Market is primarily aimed at people with low incomes.

arts-and-crafts-christmas-market-in-gato.name: Arts and Crafts Christmas Market in Gatow
arts-and-crafts-christmas-market-in-gato.description: A well-rounded mix of arts and crafts, festive music and charitable causes characterizes the small and cozy Christmas market in Gatow.

advent-market-at-domaene-dahlem.name: Advent Market at Domäne Dahlem
advent-market-at-domaene-dahlem.dates_raw: On all weekends in Advent (November 28 and 29, December 5, 6, 12, 13, 19, and 20, 2026)
advent-market-at-domaene-dahlem.description: A cozy estate atmosphere, selected stalls and a colorful program for children: the Advent market at the Domäne Dahlem has a lot to offer.

advent-market-in-leonhardtstrasse.name: Advent Market in Leonhardtstraße
advent-market-in-leonhardtstrasse.description: On the second Advent, Charlottenburg's Leonhardtstraße is transformed into a cozy Advent mile where you can browse for presents.

advent-market-on-karl-august-platz.name: Advent Market on Karl-August-Platz
advent-market-on-karl-august-platz.description: Those in search of unique Christmas presents will find what they are looking for on the first three Sundays of Advent at the arts and crafts market on Karl-August-Platz.

advent-market-on-kollwitzplatz.name: Advent Market on Kollwitzplatz
advent-market-on-kollwitzplatz.dates_raw: On all Sundays in Advent 2026 (29 November, 6, 13 and 20 December 2026)
advent-market-on-kollwitzplatz.description: The Advent Market on Kollwitzplatz offers gifts, goods and foods produced under fair social and eco-friendly conditions.

berlin-dog-christmas-market.name: Berlin Dog Christmas Market

christmas-in-westend.name: Christmas in Westend
christmas-in-westend.description: Every year during Advent, a Christmassy trunked animal invites you to the Christmas market in Preußenallee.

christmas-market-at-berlin-city-hall.name: Christmas Market at Berlin City Hall

christmas-market-at-charlottenburg-palac.name: Christmas Market at Charlottenburg Palace

christmas-market-at-charlottenburg-palac.description: With its romantic setting and magnificent illuminations, the Christmas market at Charlottenburg Palace is popular with Berliners and visitors alike for good reason.

christmas-market-at-spaeth-sche-baumschu.name: Christmas Market at Späth'sche Baumschulen

christmas-market-at-the-berlin-animal-sh.name: Christmas Market at the Berlin Animal Shelter

christmas-market-at-the-berlin-animal-sh.description: The Berlin Animal Shelter traditionally organizes the "Christmas Festival for Animals" every year during the Advent season. The highlight is the gift-giving in the kennels and cabins.

christmas-market-at-the-humboldt-forum.name: Christmas Market at the Humboldt Forum

christmas-market-in-alt-rixdorf.name: Christmas Market in Alt-Rixdorf

christmas-market-in-spandau.name: Christmas Market in Spandau

christmas-market-in-spandau.description: In Advent, the streets and alleys in the old town of Spandau change into a beautiful Christmas world complete with market stalls and a renaissance fair.

christmas-market-on-breitscheidplatz.name: Christmas Market on Breitscheidplatz
christmas-market-on-breitscheidplatz.description: This Christmas market in Berlin's western center is worth a visit while shopping on famous Kurfürstendamm.

christmas-market-on-gendarmenmarkt.name: Christmas Market on Gendarmenmarkt
christmas-market-on-gendarmenmarkt.description: Located on one of the most beautiful squares in Berlin, this Christmas Market offers quality decorations, food and entertainment.

finnish-advent-bazaar.name: Finnish Advent Bazaar

holy-shit-shopping.name: Holy Shit Shopping

lgbtiqa-winterdays-and-christmas-avenue.name: LGBTIQA Winterdays and Christmas Avenue

lgbtiqa-winterdays-and-christmas-avenue.description: At the LGBTQIA Winterdays and the Christmas market on Nollendorfplatz, atmospheric lighting, a varied stage program and high-quality delicacies await visitors.

lucia-christmas-market-at-kulturbrauerei.name: Lucia Christmas Market at Kulturbrauerei

lucia-christmas-market-at-kulturbrauerei.description: The Christmas market in the Kulturbrauerei attracts visitors with its contemplative atmosphere, a warm and cozy ambience and a daily cultural program.

medieval-christmas-market-at-the-raw-com.name: Medieval Christmas Market at the RAW Compound

pankow-advent-market-at-heynhoefe.name: Pankow Advent Market at Heynhöfe

pankow-advent-market-at-heynhoefe.description: For several years now, the Heynhöfe business park has been transformed into a cozy Christmas mile in December where neighborhood residents, Berliners and visitors meet.

sustainable-christmas-market-on-sophiens.name: Sustainable Christmas Market on Sophienstraße

swedish-christmas-bazaar.name: Swedish Christmas Bazaar

wein-nachtsmarkt-at-ludwig-beck-platz.name: Wein-Nachtsmarkt at Ludwig-Beck-Platz

cjd-advent-market.name: CJD Advent Market

christmas-market-at-villa-donnersmarck.name: Christmas Market at Villa Donnersmarck

christmas-market-at-the-karlshorst-racin.name: Christmas Market at the Karlshorst Racing Track

christmas-market-on-alice-salomon-platz.name: Christmas Market on Alice-Salomon-Platz

norwegian-christmas-bazaar.name: Norwegian Christmas Bazaar

christmas-market-on-marzahner-promenade.name: Christmas Market on Marzahner Promenade

british-christmas-market.name: British Christmas Market

african-winter-market.name: African Winter Market
african-winter-market.description: If you are still looking for unusual Christmas presents, you should stop by the African goods market: This is where African culture, fashion and cuisine come together.

italian-christmas-market.name: Italian Christmas Market

japanese-christmas-market-of-manufactori.name: Japanese Christmas Market of Manufactories
japanese-christmas-market-of-manufactori.description: This Japanese Christmas market in Tiergarten is all about kōgei, the traditional crafts of Japan.

japanese-christmas-market.name: Japanese Christmas Market
japanese-christmas-market.description: This Christmas market is all about Japan. Visitors can sample Japanese food, make toys and purchase art and crafty gifts.

winterquartier-berlin.name: Winterquartier Berlin

culinary-christmas-market-in-schoeneberg.name: Culinary Christmas Market in Schöneberg

christmas-market-in-zehlendorf.name: Christmas Market in Zehlendorf

winter-world-on-potsdamer-platz.name: Winter World on Potsdamer Platz

weihnachtsrodeo-design-market.name: Weihnachtsrodeo Design Market
weihnachtsrodeo-design-market.description: During Advent, the Colosseum hosts a Christmas market with a difference. Designers present creative gift ideas in a rather unique location.

weddingmarkt-christmas-edition.name: Weddingmarkt - Christmas Edition

designer-christmas-market.name: Designer Christmas Market

winter-dream-at-hauptbahnhof.name: Winter Dream at Hauptbahnhof

christmas-market-on-wilmersdorfer-strass.name: Christmas Market on Wilmersdorfer Straße
christmas-market-on-wilmersdorfer-strass.description: The pedestrian zone on Wilmersdorfer Straße gets into the Christmas spirit at the end of the year.

christmas-market-at-the-broehan-museum.name: Christmas Market at the Bröhan Museum

advent-market-at-charlottenburg-town-hal.name: Advent market at Charlottenburg Town Hall

kiezweihnacht.name: KiezWeihnacht

all-inclusive-christmas-market-at-sprees.name: All Inclusive Christmas Market at Spreespeicher

heissa-holzmarkt.name: Heissa Holzmarkt

gluehwald-at-uber-platz.name: Glühwald at Uber Platz

kinky-christmas-market.name: Kinky Christmas Market
kinky-christmas-market.description: Berlin’s first kinky Christmas market has been a fixture in the capital since 2023 and will be back again in 2026.

merry-markthalle.name: Merry Markthalle
merry-markthalle.dates_raw: On the last three Sundays of Advent in 2026 (6, 13 and 20 December 2026)
merry-markthalle.description: Markthalle Neun is transformed into a cozy Christmas paradise during the Advent season.

solidarity-winter-market-in-goerlitzer-p.name: Solidarity Winter Market in Görlitzer Park

advent-bazaar-at-the-christuskirche.name: Advent Bazaar at the Christuskirche

artisan-christmas-market-at-gotisches-ha.name: Artisan Christmas Market at Gotisches Haus

winter-market-in-the-atelier-gardens.name: Winter market in the Atelier Gardens

christmas-market-on-lehmann-s-farm.name: Christmas Market on Lehmann's Farm

christmas-market-in-lichtenrade.name: Christmas Market in Lichtenrade

christmas-at-tempelhof-airport.name: Christmas at Tempelhof Airport

christmas-market-around-the-marienfelde-.name: Christmas Market Around the Marienfelde Village Church

christmas-market-at-alpinia.name: Christmas Market at Alpinia

christmas-market-in-alt-kaulsdorf.name: Christmas Market in Alt-Kaulsdorf

christmas-market-at-the-naturhof-malchow.name: Christmas Market at the Naturhof Malchow

christmas-market-at-orankesee-lido.name: Christmas Market at Orankesee Lido

advent-market-at-hanff-s-ruh.name: Advent Market at Hanff's Ruh
advent-market-at-hanff-s-ruh.opening_times: Saturday from 12 noon to 8 pm, Sunday from 11 am to 7 pm
advent-market-at-hanff-s-ruh.description: Contemplative music, mulled wine and candied apples: the Advent market in Köpenick focuses on tradition and aims to awaken childhood memories.

christmas-market-at-the-christuskirche-i.name: Christmas Market at the Christuskirche in Oberschöneweide
christmas-market-at-the-christuskirche-i.description: In Köpenick, the Christmas season starts early: The Christmas market in front of the church in Oberschöneweide traditionally opens its doors on the Saturday before the first Advent.

christmas-market-in-oberschoeneweide.name: Christmas Market in Oberschöneweide
christmas-market-in-oberschoeneweide.description: The "Oberschöne Weihnachtsmarkt" takes place in a former industrial hall and attracts visitors with an entertainment program.

christmas-market-at-koepenick-palace.name: Christmas Market at Köpenick Palace
christmas-market-at-koepenick-palace.opening_times: Friday from 2 pm to 10 pm, Saturday from 12 noon to 10 pm, Sunday from 12 noon to 8 pm
christmas-market-at-koepenick-palace.description: Located in the old town of Berlin-Köpenick with its cobblestone alleys and Baroque palace, this Christmas market is one of the most atmospheric in Berlin.

christmas-market-on-boelschestrasse.name: Christmas Market on Bölschestraße
christmas-market-on-boelschestrasse.opening_times: Friday from 2 pm to 10 pm, Saturday from 12 noon to 10 pm, Sunday from 12 noon to 8 pm
christmas-market-on-boelschestrasse.description: During Advent, the marketplace on the Bölschestraße in Friedrichshagen is transformed into a romantic Christmas market.

sustainable-christmas-market-in-lichtenb.name: Sustainable Christmas Market in Lichtenberg
sustainable-christmas-market-in-lichtenb.description: Organic mulled wine and fairtrade chocolate: this Christmas market in Lichtenberg scores with fairl and sustainable products.

christmas-lights-at-lichtenberg-city-hal.name: Christmas Lights at Lichtenberg City Hall
christmas-lights-at-lichtenberg-city-hal.description: For more than 30 years, the Lichtenberg District Office has been inviting people to enjoy the pre-Christmas season in a neighborly atmosphere on the first day of Advent.

advent-market-in-alt-marzahn.name: Advent Market in Alt-Marzahn
advent-market-in-alt-marzahn.description: The listed medieval town of Alt-Marzahn gets Christmassy at the beginning of December. The small Christmas market on the village green is relaxed and family-friendly.

biesdorf-christmas-village.name: Biesdorf Christmas Village
biesdorf-christmas-village.description: Elsterwerdaer Platz becomes a Christmas village. On Fridays and Saturdays, families in particular can look forward to a wide range of Christmas activities.

christmas-market-at-biesdorf-palace.name: Christmas Market at Biesdorf Palace
christmas-market-at-biesdorf-palace.description: The picturesque Biesdorf Palace Park lends this Christmas market in Marzahn a special setting.

advent-market-in-papierstrasse.name: Advent Market in Papierstraße
advent-market-in-papierstrasse.description: Somewhat hidden in Alt-Reinickendorf, the Advent market in Papierstraße takes place in open workshop spaces.

winter-market-at-the-former-tegel-airpor.name: Winter Market at the former Tegel Airport
winter-market-at-the-former-tegel-airpor.opening_times: Saturday from 2 pm to 10 pm, Sunday from 2 pm to 8 pm
winter-market-at-the-former-tegel-airpor.description: A winter market with a programme of events is taking place for the second time this year at the old cargo canteen of the former Tegel Airport.

advent-market-at-the-tegel-forestry-offi.name: Advent Market at the Tegel Forestry Office
advent-market-at-the-tegel-forestry-offi.description: With a campfire and game sales, the Advent market at the Tegel Forestry Office is a bit more rustic, but all the cozier for it.

adventsbasar-der-kirchengemeinde-luebars.name: Adventsbasar der Kirchengemeinde Lübars
adventsbasar-der-kirchengemeinde-luebars.description: An der Grenze zum grünen Brandenburg lädt der nachbarschaftliche Weihnachtsmarkt in Lübars dazu ein, die vorweihnachtliche Zeit gemeinsam zu genießen.

arts-and-crafts-christmas-market-in-froh.name: Arts and Crafts Christmas Market in Frohnau
arts-and-crafts-christmas-market-in-froh.description: On the second weekend of Advent, visitors can shop for unusual gift ideas in the heart of Berlin-Frohnau at the local Christmas market.

weihnachtsfest-in-der-alten-fasanerie.name: Weihnachtsfest in der Alten Fasanerie
weihnachtsfest-in-der-alten-fasanerie.description: Das Weihnachtsfest in der Fasanerie ist besonders bei Familien mit Kindern beliebt und sorgt für leuchtende Augen.

advent-bazaar-at-tegel-prison.name: Advent Bazaar at Tegel Prison
advent-bazaar-at-tegel-prison.description: This cozy bazaar offers gifts, children's toys, baked goods, Advent arrangements, glass design and much more - all made in the Tegel Prison.

weihnachtsmarkt-am-kadewe.name: Weihnachtsmarkt am KaDeWe
weihnachtsmarkt-am-kadewe.opening_times: Sonntag bis Donnerstag von 11 bis 21 Uhr, Freitag und Samstag von 11 bis 22 Uhr, 24. Dezember von 11 bis 15 Uhr, 25. und 26. Dezember von 13 bis 21 Uhr, 31. Dezember von 11 bis 3 Uhr, 01. Januar von 13 bis 22 Uhr
weihnachtsmarkt-am-kadewe.description: Auf dem Wittenbergplatz findet ein stimmungsvoller Weihnachtsmarkt in direkter Nähe zum berühmten KaDeWe statt.

friedenauer-engelmarkt.name: Friedenauer Engelmarkt
friedenauer-engelmarkt.description: Der Breslauer Platz verwandelt sich am zweiten Advent in einen weihnachtlichen Engelmarkt.

christmas-market-in-alt-steglitz.name: Christmas Market in Alt-Steglitz
christmas-market-in-alt-steglitz.description: Alt-Steglitz is ringing in the Christmas season with choirs and brass music.

schauriger-weihnachtsmarkt-im-goerzwerk.name: Schauriger Weihnachtsmarkt im Goerzwerk
schauriger-weihnachtsmarkt-im-goerzwerk.description: Das Goerzwerk lädt zum Weihnachtsmarkt, auf dem unter anderem ein schauriger Krampus umherstreift.

weihnachtsmarkt-to-go-im-kranoldkiez.name: Weihnachtsmarkt to go im Kranoldkiez
weihnachtsmarkt-to-go-im-kranoldkiez.description: Der gesamte Kranoldkiez verwandelt sich am Samstag vor dem dritten Advent in einen dezentralen Weihnachtsmarkt.

weihnachtsmarkt-in-der-abenteueroase.name: Weihnachtsmarkt in der Abenteueroase
weihnachtsmarkt-in-der-abenteueroase.description: Weihnachten bei den Pfadfindern: Die Abenteueroase in Steglitz verwandelt sich Anfang Dezember in einen gemütlichen Weihnachtsmarkt für Familien.

social-christmas-market-at-stadtschloss-.name: Social Christmas Market at Stadtschloss Moabit
social-christmas-market-at-stadtschloss-.description: In 2026, Goldnetz’s social Christmas market will once again take place at Moabit City Palace.

altglienicker-adventsmarkt.name: Altglienicker Adventsmarkt
altglienicker-adventsmarkt.description: Unweit des S-Bahnhof Altglienicke wird es am zweiten Advent gemütlich weihnachtlich.

christmas-in-blankenburg.name: Christmas in Blankenburg
christmas-in-blankenburg.description: The small district of Blankenburg celebrates the holiday season with its very own Christmas festival, which has been taking place for over ten years.

advent-bazaar-of-the-albert-schweitzer-f.name: Advent Bazaar of the Albert Schweitzer Foundation
advent-bazaar-of-the-albert-schweitzer-f.description: In the run-up to Christmas, the Three Wise Men and Santa visit Weißensee: a cozy Advent bazaar is held on the grounds of the Albert Schweitzer Foundation.

advent-market-at-oekowerk.name: Advent Market at Ökowerk
advent-market-at-oekowerk.description: A particularly contemplative Christmas market awaits families and visitors at the Ökowerk nature conservation center.

waldweihnachtsmarkt-am-forstamt-grunewal.name: Waldweihnachtsmarkt am Forstamt Grunewald
waldweihnachtsmarkt-am-forstamt-grunewal.description: Der stimmungsvolle Weihnachtsmarkt am Forstamt Grunewald gehört für viele Berlinerinnen und Berliner fest zur Vorweihnachtszeit.

christmas-market-at-st-michaels-heim.name: Christmas Market at St.-Michaels-Heim
christmas-market-at-st-michaels-heim.opening_times: Saturday from 2 pm to 8 pm, Sunday from 12 noon to 6 pm
christmas-market-at-st-michaels-heim.description: For over 40 years, the non-profit association Johannisches Sozialwerk has been hosting the Christmas market at their guesthouse, the St.-Michaels-Heim. For many visitors, the cozy market is like a trip back in time.

veganer-weihnachtsmarkt-auf-dem-fehrbell.name: Veganer Weihnachtsmarkt auf dem Fehrbelliner Platz
veganer-weihnachtsmarkt-auf-dem-fehrbell.description: Weihnachten vegan feiern: Auf dem Fehrbelliner Platz können Berliner und Besucher an den Adventswochenenden vegane Leckereien und Geschenke erwerben.

arts-and-crafts-christmas-market-on-mexi.name: Arts and Crafts Christmas Market on Mexikoplatz
arts-and-crafts-christmas-market-on-mexi.dates_raw: On all Sundays in Advent 2026 (November 29, December 6, 13 and 20, 2026)
arts-and-crafts-christmas-market-on-mexi.description: The Christmas market on Mexikoplatz has been taking place every December for over thirty years and can therefore rightly call itself a Berlin institution.

christmas-market-at-the-grunewald-huntin.name: Christmas Market at the Grunewald Hunting Lodge
christmas-market-at-the-grunewald-huntin.description: A castle deep in the forest, brightly lit market stalls and the smell of Christmas treats... The Christmas market at Grunewald Hunting Lodge creates a festive atmosphere.

winter-wonderland-im-britzer-garten.name: Winter Wonderland im Britzer Garten
winter-wonderland-im-britzer-garten.dates_raw: An allen Adventswochenenden 2026 (27. bis 29. November, 04. bis 06., 11. bis 13. sowie 18. bis 20. Dezember)
winter-wonderland-im-britzer-garten.admission: Nur Parkeintritt (2 Euro, ermäßigt 1 Euro, Kinder bis einschließlich 5 Jahre Eintritt frei)
winter-wonderland-im-britzer-garten.description: Der Britzer Garten beherbergt in diesem Jahr zum ersten Mal einen stimmungsvollen Weihnachtsmarkt: das Winter Wonderland.

nordberliner-weihnachtsrummel.name: Nordberliner Weihnachtsrummel
nordberliner-weihnachtsrummel.description: Berlin bekommt in diesem Jahr einen neuen Weihnachtsrummel: Wer Weihnachtsstimmung mit rasanten Fahrgeschäften verbinden möchte, wird in Tegel fündig.

christmas-market-on-lohmuehlen-island.name: Christmas market on Lohmühlen Island
christmas-market-on-lohmuehlen-island.opening_times: Friday from 4 pm to 10 pm, Saturday and Sunday from 2 pm to 10 pm
christmas-market-on-lohmuehlen-island.description: This year, for the first time, Freischwimmer and Ipse Ufer are organising a joint Christmas market on the banks of the Flutgraben.
